0022600120.text: The Cavaliers (1-1, 1-0 at home, on a W1 streak) host the Timberwolves (2-0, 2-0 on the road, on a W2 streak), with Cleveland 2nd in the Central, 1 game back, and 8th in the East, while Minnesota is 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Cleveland has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Cavaliers won the last meeting 146-134 in Cleveland on January 10, 2026.
